title: An action annihilating all v-directional derivatives is invariant under translation by v
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) and v ∈ ℝ^P. Assume R.action(γ) = 0 for all test forms β, γ ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with γ(y) = Dβ(y)[v] (fderiv ℝ β y v) for every y. Then R.action(y ↦ ω(v + y)) = R.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), (∀ β γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = fderiv ℝ (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y v) → R.action (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.action (fun y => (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (v + y)) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
